async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Orders page using the relative URL from the accessibility tree
    await page.goto('/admin/sales/order/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter by status 'Cancelled'
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('canceled')
    # Apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Apply Filters').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by order date descending to get most recent
    await page.get_by_role('columnheader', name='Order Date').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Extract the date from the first row in the table
    first_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(1)  # nth(0) is header, nth(1) is first data row
    date_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(2)  # Assuming date is in the third column
    date_text = await date_cell.text_content()
    return date_text.strip()
